justifications.guard: Guard tests call WithPrefix, AsTagged and WithSegments with invalid arguments; key generation is covered by unit tests.

justifications.guard: Guard tests call Configure with a null action and every Cache*Value extension with a null faker; generation bodies are unit-tested.
justifications.unit: Unit tests generate each cache value kind; a few range-edge branches are not driven.

justifications.guard: Guard tests call every extension with a null receiver and with out-of-range arguments plus invalid locales; the success paths are unit-tested.

justifications.property: Property tests drive the id and value-object extensions over generated seeds; the remaining lines are generation bodies covered by unit tests.

justifications.unit: OutboxMessageFakerTests exercise all state builders and the generated message.
